package service

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for service_method_returns_http_status: Services that return raw HTTP status codes or transport response metadata.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: warning.
type InventoryService struct {
	repo InventoryRepository
}

func (s *InventoryService) Create(ctx context.Context, name string, quantity int) (int, error) {
	if name == "" {
		return http.StatusBadRequest, nil
	}
	if quantity < 0 {
		return http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, nil
	}
	if err := s.repo.Insert(ctx, name, quantity); err != nil {
		return http.StatusInternalServerError, err
	}
	return http.StatusCreated, nil
}

func (s *InventoryService) Update(ctx context.Context, id string, quantity int) (int, error) {
	if id == "" {
		return http.StatusBadRequest, nil
	}
	if err := s.repo.UpdateQuantity(ctx, id, quantity); err != nil {
		return http.StatusInternalServerError, err
	}
	return http.StatusOK, nil
}

type InventoryRepository interface {
	Insert(ctx context.Context, name string, quantity int) error
	UpdateQuantity(ctx context.Context, id string, quantity int) error
}
